actions.text: Before cleaning or handling moving parts, stop the robot, switch it off and unplug the charging base if safe. Do not force anything or open electrical housings. This is Repera's safety limit.

actions.text: Before cleaning or handling moving parts, stop the robot, switch it off and unplug the charging base if safe. Do not force anything or open electrical housings. This is Repera's safety limit.

Stop cleaning, switch off and disconnect charging power. Release the yellow frame tabs and lift out the rubber brushes. Remove loose hair from their caps, axles and square/hexagonal ends. Refit the caps and brushes, matching peg shapes and colors, then close the frame. Stop if anything needs force.

actions.text: Before cleaning or handling moving parts, stop the robot, switch it off and unplug the charging base if safe. Do not force anything or open electrical housings. This is Repera's safety limit.
